findings.title: totality without need
findings.claim: The heavens and earth delimit the owned cosmic field; the final predicates make that possession non-acquisitive and the possessor's worth independent of what is possessed.
findings.mechanism: The carriers ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ and ٱلْأَرْضِ meet as opposite poles of one domain. The carrier ٱلْغَنِىُّ then meets the fronted ownership over ma within that domain, so possession does not read as acquisition for need; ٱلْحَمِيدُ meets that same totality and the needlessness predicate, so praiseworthiness is not conferred by possessions.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees total ownership without need, and praise whose ground is not the owned field.
findings.containment: The focus wording about what is in the heavens and earth remains intact; this adds the relation between ownership, needlessness, and praise without importing the HFT's wider unanchored context or a human acquisition model.

epistemic.reason: Each HFT word index and root agrees with supplied focus QAC. The interaction is grounded in the local merism and predicate sequence, while the legacy_unbound synthesis roles remain attributed.

findings.title: sufficiency that benefits
findings.claim: The paired predicates allow needlessness to open toward sufficiency for others, with praise registering benefit without filling any divine lack.
findings.mechanism: The carrier ٱلْغَنِىُّ contacts the distinct ٱلْحَمِيدُ predicate through their adjacent identity-predicate relation: independence from need can be heard as positive adequacy for others, and the following praise predicate can register that delivered sufficiency after experience.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can hear independence as outward adequacy as well as absence of need, with praise registering benefit.
findings.containment: This remains an attributed relational reading of the paired predicates. It does not claim a need in God, name a recipient or evaluator, or assert an explicit trial event.

epistemic.reason: The HFT root and word coordinates match the supplied focus QAC forms and the local predicate order. The benefit and experience relations remain attributed because the source is legacy_unbound.
